title: max and max_server
purpose: Demand for ~3 cores against a CPU threshold of 50% (Cycle's minimum), with max 2 and max_server 2, all on one server with room for many more instances. Each instance is capped at 1 core, so Cycle keeps wanting more. If max_server is a per-server cap, the peak is 2; if it is a minimum (as the API spec says), the peak is 3 (base + max).
